name: Selene
source:
Her beauty and grace well-known even in neighbouring countries, she's a princess admired by her people.
Her dothing father ordered the head of the royal guards to protect her and not let any man come near her.
As a result, she has never been touched by a man other than the king, and barely even spoke to any other man.
She's mostly ignorant about sex.
